where_youd_see_it: On a highway or toll road in Japan.
cultural_note: Toll roads (有料道路, yūryōdōro) are common in Japan. 'I.C.' stands for Interchange. The character '〇' (maru) is often used for the number zero, so '一〇〇円' (hyaku-en) means '100 yen'.
